## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle early-Qīng *novice-precept primer* by **Hóngzàn** ([弘贊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%98%E8%B4%8A), 1612–1686) of *Dǐnghúshān* — a *117-stanza versified* condensation of the *Shāmí jiè jīng* 沙彌戒經 and *Shìshī fǎ* 事師法 (master-attendance protocol), with the author's own running interlinear annotation. Author signature: *Yuèdōng Dǐnghú shāmén shì Hóngzàn Zàishēn zhù* 粤東鼎湖沙門釋　弘贊在犙　註.

**Abstract**

The *Shāmí xuéjiè yíguǐ sòngzhù* is the principal **versified novice-primer** of the early-Qīng Vinaya revival. Where Zhūhóng's late-Míng *Yàolüè* (commented in [KR6k0228](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0228) and [KR6k0232](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0232)) treats the same material in prose, Hóngzàn's stanzas were designed for **memorisation**: 117 stanzas at 20 characters each = 2,340 characters total, the volume of a single afternoon's recital. The author's own *zhù* supplies the interpretive framework, citation by citation. Composition is bracketed by Hóngzàn's *Dǐnghúshān* mature career; `notBefore`–`notAfter` are accordingly set 1660–1686.
